text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-senpai! Happy, happy birthday to 
youuuu, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Please, by all means, try my special 
homemade miso soup today, deesu!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
El...! Mmm~, exxxxcellent! Your 
thoughtfulness makes me truly happy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to tell me all about it? 
Just how passionate of a miso soup you 
have prepared for me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes!! El's special miso soup, it is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Made with plenty of spicy miso, it's... 
"Passionate Miso Soup!" YEEEEEEES!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The new frontier of miso soup you're 
showing us! A horizon of fresh 
possibilities! I can't wait!
